reviewStage: Final 644-part secondary-detail model with packed surface atlas version 3
similarityNote: The 90 percent likeness target is not an objectively measured or confirmed percentage. Reference fidelity is described through the visible features and remaining differences below.

additionalViewsInspected.finding: Confirms perforated shell thickness, new shoulder seam inlays, recessed fasteners, side compression bands and visible coating wear.
Confirms the rear service armor, radar support, optical shell seams and visible surface variation. No new exterior interpenetration was found in the neutral oblique views.

cameraScope: Matched front, rear and side orthographic photography, plus two actual oblique renders. The asset remains one coherent model; minor inconsistencies among the reference images are not reproduced through per-view deformation.
confirmedReferenceFeatures: Broad shallow ivory skirt, separated sloped panels, lower notches, dark anchor recesses, diagonal braces and open anchor eyes.
Large circular side armor inside stepped octagonal frames; the final pass adds concentric segmented compression bands and chamfered service covers.
Eight long dark tubes, retaining hoops and a continuous thick perforated tapering guard with real apertures.
Asymmetric thin radar disc and spherical optical head, separate forks/journals and newly visible optical shell seams.
Front and rear folded shoulder armor now has inset perimeter seams, recessed edge fasteners, return clips and small frame fittings.
Rear grille and service plates, warm ivory and graphite separation, amber fixtures and a gold geometric emblem on one side.
The final shared atlas has visible localized wear, coating variation and dark contact tones; the former nearly uniform surface is superseded.

remainingReferenceDifferences.observation: The central front aperture is still wider and more regular than the reference. Lower braces, rear armor layering and sensor brackets retain simpler forms despite the added secondary fittings.
Shroud holes use a coherent repeated layout rather than the exact irregular reference pattern. Fine fastener placement, small panel borders and retaining-ring details are interpretive.

Visible wear and coating variation are now present, but their grain, distribution and contrast differ from the reference. The reference has denser sharp scratches and irregular edge damage; the current game atlas reads as softer mottling and local edge wear.
The optical lens, its surrounding housing and amber fixture sockets remain less deeply layered than the reference.

mechanicalConclusion.note: The reviewed game-art geometry is coherent across the required four motion groups. This does not certify real engineering or Unity runtime behavior.

deliveryLanguage: Describe the rebuilt reference features, the actual secondary-detail and surface improvements, and the verified game-art mechanical motion. Retain the specific visual differences; do not label 90 percent likeness as measured or confirmed.
